# Saral

> Saral is a loan advisory agent for Indian personal-loan borrowers. A deterministic rules engine (ZEN) makes the
> decision; a LangGraph agent explains it in plain English, Hindi or Telugu, suggests next steps, runs what-if
> estimates and answers policy questions with citations. It is reached through a Frappe borrower portal with a
> CopilotKit chat island, and by voice through a LiveKit worker. All data is synthetic.

Saral explains, it never decides. Bajaj Finance is a public reference lender, not a partner. Thresholds are a
prototype. Voice speech on branch `feat/gnani-voice` uses Gnani Prisma v3 (speech-to-text) and Timbre v3
(text-to-speech, voice Tarika); phone callers verify on the keypad (caller ID plus the last 4 digits of one factor),
which is demo-grade authentication.
